answer_sentences.text: Beyond standard EMI loans, the reset-related requirements also apply to all equated instalment-based personal loans of different periodicities, regardless of whether they are linked to an external benchmark or an internal benchmark.
answer_sentences.quote: Apart from the EMI based loans, these instructions would also apply, mutatis mutandis, to all equated instalment-based personal loans of different periodicities irrespective of whether they are linked to an external benchmark or an internal benchmark.
